title: Bug: pytest INTERNALERROR in conditional_mark plugin when build_version lacks a dot
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

In `conditional_marks/__init__.py`, `evaluate_conditions()` combined multiple YAML conditions using `all([f(c) for c in conditions])` / `any([f(c) for c in conditions])`.

Because the list comprehension runs first, every condition is evaluated before `all()`/`any()` which can cause errors if rules are written as a guard + a follow-up check, we ran into errors specifically for `syslog/test_syslog.py` and `system_health/test_system_health.py` e.g.
```
conditions:
  - "branch in ['internal-202012']"
  - "build_version.split('.')[1].isdigit() and int(build_version.split('.')[1]) <= 33"
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Use an image build that does not include a . / follow the standard naming e.g. `000000.00`

Try to run `syslog/test_syslog.py` or `system_health/test_system_health.py`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Get runtime error e.g.:
```
INTERNALERROR>   File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt/tests/common/plugins/conditional_mark/__init__.py", line 660, in evaluate_conditions
INTERNALERROR>     return all([evaluate_condition(dynamic_update_skip_reason, mark_details, c, basic_facts, session)
INTERNALERROR>                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
INTERNALERROR>   File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt/tests/common/plugins/conditional_mark/__init__.py", line 627, in evaluate_condition
INTERNALERROR>     raise RuntimeError('Failed to evaluate condition, raw_condition={}, condition_str={}'.format(
INTERNALERROR> RuntimeError: Failed to evaluate condition, raw_condition=build_version.split('.')[1].isdigit() and int(build_version.split('.')[1]) <= 44, condition_str=build_version.split('.')[1].isdigit() and int(build_version.split('.')[1]) <= 44
```

Shouldn't get runtime error

### Approach

When running tests with unstandardised build with no dot (e.g. `internal_26_08_26`) - run into errors during conditional_mark parsing specifically expecting `000000.00` format.
